DEVOURING CULTIST
CR 8

XP 4,800
CE Medium humanoid (human)
Init +2, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 12, flat-footed 22 (+2 Dex, +6 armor, +6 natural)
hp 126 (11d10 +66)
Fort +13, Ref +5, Will +8
Body spikes; Immunities mind-affecting spells and effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +20/15/10 (1d10 +10/19-20 plus grab)
Ranged Spike Volley +13/+8/+3 (4d6)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 15, Con 15, Int 12, Wis 8, Cha 17
Base Atk +11; CMB +18 (+20 bull rush), CMD 30 (32 vs bull rush)
Feats Improved Bull Rush, Power Attack

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Body Spikes (Ex)

All melee attacks against a devouring cultist cause the attacker 1 piercing damage. Additionally, creatures a devouring cultist successfully grapples suffer 4d6 piercing damage.

Devour (Ex)

This standard action can only be us ed if the target is grappled. The grappled creature suffers 10d6 piercing damage. An Escape Artist check DC 20 is granted to reduce the damage to half. If the check is failed, the cultist is healed by half of the damage dealt by this attack (rounded down).
